---
title: "Interactive Player Explorer"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

players <- read_csv("data/players.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(bmi = round((weight / (height_inches^2)) * 703, 1))
```

## Explore Active Players

Search and sort through 2024 MLB player profiles. You can search by player name, team, or position to see how individual athletes compare across physical metrics.

```{r}
players |>
  select(
    Player = full_name,
    Team = team_name,
    Position = position,
    `Height (in)` = height_inches,
    `Weight (lbs)` = weight,
    BMI = bmi,
    Bats = bat_side,
    Throws = pitch_hand
  ) |>
  datatable(
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```
